verdict.rationale: Paperspace's marketing and docs explicitly promise SSH with your own key and full root access to GPU VMs (paperspace-docs-12/19/21/31, paperspace-docs-2), but a hands-on community report states the opposite experience: 'it's an uphill battle to get ssh access; they create a pointless virtual console instead of simple ssh access' (paperspace-comm-7), directly contradicting the vendor claim. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that SSH root access works reliably in practice, and no evidence resolving this discrepancy.
